methodology.query: One untimed warm-up before in-process fine, portal and Recast queries. Existing fine worker additionally measures full invocation including snapshot/startup. No threat costs or refuge selection in any arm.
methodology.validation: Same native no-slide microstep trace at <=128 client units, after wire quantization, from exact start to exact goal; live bodies, minimum floor, mandatory exclusions.
methodology.limits: Offline geometry evidence only; no game packets or survival measurements. Static Recast has no body detour or threat-cost adapter. Portal graph is a sampled prototype.

cases.source: tools/m59-fine-safeleg-test.mjs:45-60 arrival and exact fineCut goal. Open only door server tag1 at ceiling height1150 through the existing ceiling-door helper. Same endpoints as the closed case.

grid_context.note: Square search only; excludes fine following, bodies and packet proof.

bakes.limitation: Finite portal samples may miss valid passages; no mesh erosion, jump links or live executor changes.
